The '''Nebula Raiders''' were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] led by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Ssurussk]] that were based in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Nebula Raiders operated a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that included a number of [[Gun tug/Legends|gun tugs]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]].<ref name="SotG" />
